title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Why when I create new users do they get full access by default
summary: New users in Business Central automatically receive full access to their first company based on their assigned license. Administrators can prevent this by modifying permission sets in the License Configuration page.
key_points: New users get default permissions from their security groups and from the licence they are assigned
By default a licence such as Business Central Essential grants full access to the first company a user logs into
In the Licence Configuration page, edit the licence, turn on Customise Permissions and delete permission sets such as D365 BUS FULL ACCESS
Partner access can be controlled the same way by editing the Delegated Admin agent - Partner licence

quotes.text: Now when I create a new user that's been assigned this licence they won't have full access.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical outcome of modifying license configuration to enforce principle of least privilege
